Theorem
[Optimality conditions] ↗ def:value-function ↗ def:control-cost-functional 1. ch10:10.3-thm-1\group Control Theory

For each $h > 0$ so small that $t + h \leq T$, we have \[ u(x,t) = \inf _{\alpha (\cdot ) \in \mathcal{A}} \left\{ \int _t^{t+h} h(\mathbf{x}(s), \alpha (s)) ds + u(\mathbf{x}(t+h), t+h) \right\} , \tag {7} \] where $\mathbf{x}(\cdot ) = \mathbf{x}^{\alpha (\cdot )}(\cdot )$ solves the ODE (1) for the control $\alpha (\cdot )$.

Proof

\sketch Concatenate an arbitrary control on $[t,t+h]$ with an $\epsilon $-optimal continuation from the reached state to obtain one inequality in (7). Restrict an $\epsilon $-optimal control for the full interval and use the definition of the continuation value for the reverse inequality. Let $\epsilon \downarrow 0$.

□
